version: Institutional author accepted manuscript; DOI 10.1109/MICRO61859.2024.00020 appears on physical page 1.
scope: Complete text of physical pages 3–6: benchmark construction/validation, performance interpretation, actual-system characterization, start of simulator comparison. This is selected reading, not the complete paper or simulator/source audit.

viewed_pages.scope: Table I identity/units and Figure 3 curve families; no curve digitization or measured values adopted.

findings: Physical page 3: pointer-chase on one CPU core or GPU SM measures probe latency while other cores/SMs generate configurable traffic; hardware counters supply bandwidth. Probe latency is not each LLM transaction latency.
Physical pages 3–4: huge pages and TLB/page-walk correction aim at close-to-hardware characterization. Production translation/OS work must not be subtracted from end-to-end latency.

Physical pages 4–6: read/write ratio and write-allocation change both actual traffic and sustainable throughput; logical STREAM bytes differ from hardware-counter bytes. CPU write-allocation example is not asserted for arbitrary GPU stores.
Physical pages 4–5: loaded latency rises with pressure; some configurations lose throughput at high pressure. Twice unloaded latency is this paper’s saturation convention, not a universal knee.
Physical page 6: simulator comparisons concern the archived configurations and versions, not all present-day gem5/Ramulator models; no simulation accuracy or speedup adopted.
limitations: Table I lists H100 with 132 SMs at 1.1 GHz, 4×HBM2E and 1631 GB/s; the paper’s exact board/memory-clock combination has not been reconciled with the book’s H100 SXM specification. No replacement of hardware specification or inference measurement.
Physical page 4 prose assigns 122 ns to A64FX and 129 ns to Graviton3, while Table I has the reverse. No platform latency number adopted.
Physical page 5 flattened text includes hidden/overlapping plot labels not visible in the rendered figure; visual image inspected, no values extracted from those text labels.
Full simulator implementation, CXL manufacturer curves, application stress score and complete appendix/artifact have not been read in this selected scope. No downloaded source executed.

adoption.method: Teaching calculation from fixed Qwen3 configuration plus explicitly assumed transaction/concurrency/latency inputs; empirical experiment remains planned.
